author: @parmentier7457
text:
Currently, many Indonesian nurses are recruited from Dutch healthcare institutions. The Netherlands is struggling with an ageing population and a shortage of 76,000 healthcare workers; in 2022, there were already 50,000 vacancies in healthcare. Despite the fact that the Dutch government is stimulating healthcare more explicitly, it cannot train more nurses in the short term. There are simply too few Dutch students in healthcare. 

The Dutch government also has a special visa for nurses from Indonesia that is valid for five years. It works both ways: the Dutch vacancies in healthcare are filled and the Indonesians can gain experience and knowledge. This increases the chance of work in Indonesia upon return. 

Some Dutch healthcare institutions also offer training. A requirement to work as nurse in the Netherlands is an Indonesian healthcare diploma and knowledge of English and Dutch. 

But this Indonesian nursing policy has also caused problems in the Netherlands. Due to a shortage of healthcare personnel, many healthcare institutions hired Indonesian nurses in 2021, without setting up a proper organisation. These healthcare institutions had no experience in hiring foreign nurses and have also been fined by the Dutch Health Authority for mismanagement. These healthcare institutions have also been instructed to improve their policies regarding foreign nurses. 

The Netherlands currently has between 1.5 and 2 million people with an Indonesian background and there is also a lot of aging in this diaspora. In recent decades, many nursing homes have been opened special for Indonesian, Moluccan and Surinamese-Javanese communities. Here it is sometimes desirable to be able to speak Indonesian and/or Javanese in addition to Dutch. 

Indonesian nurses work in the Netherlands according to Dutch employment conditions and salary. The average salary of a nurse in the Netherlands in 2025 is € 4,111 gross per month, with a lower limit of € 3,680 and an upper limit of € 4,542. And at least four weeks paid holiday, and 14 month salary per year.
